Main's fixture demonstrates it, inside the same PR, so the declaration was falsified before it was even read. triage.direction: a false FAIL avoided -- not_a_dump must not fire below the new page-size floor (MIN_PAGE_CHARS=100 in src/browser/verifier.py), which sits between this fixture's 37-char page and the smallest real dump in the suite, probe5-shop-listing-dump's 195-char page.
